study_plan.extension_rule: Add frames 64 and 192 to the same 8 scenes only if fewer than 200 valid matched raw candidates in total or fewer than 4 scenes have >=20 valid raw candidates; independent of quality outcomes
study_plan.primary_feasibility: not collision and not empty and 0 < mu <= 0.4
study_plan.high_rank: rank<=50 in original fixed final pool; Top1 separately
study_plan.B_evaluate: P0 all 1024 raw candidates; P1-P5 all valid matches; invalid targets remain unknown
study_plan.reference: exact label point plus transformed label view frame and representative angle/depth/width, re-evaluated; P5 separately keeps prediction point and approach

official_training_config.source: official README + utils/arguments.py; checkpoint contains epoch=10, not independent training logs

runtime.precision_note: Network inference retains TF32. Only read-only official label probe uses FP32 matrix multiplication; no prediction was changed.
runtime.compute_note: Pose calls include duplicate controls; CPU time sums completed final evaluators only, excluding preflight/failed pilot/asset hashing. Inference receipt timing does not include all setup/reprobe overhead.

historical_weight.training: 50 scenes, 6400 frames, 10 epochs, 16000 updates; history only; no candidate ID correspondence

source_caveat: Inference/label-matching/loss sources are official. Existing label generator includes operational resume/atomic-save patches; compression logic checked against raw labels. Official release epoch=10 is not independent verification of training logs.

raw_label_preflight.label_rule: official collision mask, width filter, 1.1-mu, depth-max then angle-max, original integer serialization
